title: MCV3 State Machine Specification v1
description: Schema validation cho state-machine-spec.yaml files. Dat tai: .mc-data/docs/phase3-architecture/state-machines/<entity>.yaml. Su dung boi probe P-QD10-state-machine-correctness de xac minh code tuan thu vong doi entity.

entity.description: Ten entity quan ly boi state machine (e.g. Quotation, Order, Invoice)

description.description: Mo ta ngan ve vong doi entity

states.description: Danh sach tat ca trang thai hop le cua entity

initial_state.description: Trang thai khoi dau (phai co trong states[])

terminal_states.description: Trang thai ket thuc — khong co transition ra khoi state nay (e.g. CONVERTED, REJECTED)

transitions.description: Danh sach cac transition hop le giua cac trang thai

forbidden_transitions.description: Danh sach cac transition KHONG duoc phep (tuong minh hoa de probe kiem tra)

guards.description: Dieu kien bao ve per-state: ai duoc phep o trang thai nay, can gi de vao/roi

actions.description: Dinh nghia tuong minh cac actions (optional — actions co the dinh nghia inline trong transitions)

action.description: Ten hanh dong kich hoat transition (e.g. submit, approve, reject, expire)

oneOf.description: Vai tro duoc phep thuc hien transition (string don)
Nhieu vai tro duoc phep thuc hien transition

role.description: Vai tro duoc phep thuc hien transition

condition.description: Dieu kien guard phai thoa man truoc khi thuc hien transition (optional, e.g. 'items.length > 0')

side_effects.description: Danh sach hieu ung phu sau transition (e.g. send_email, update_inventory, notify_system)

reason.description: Ly do tuong minh chua transition nay bi cam (de probe emit signal ro rang)

role_required.description: Role can thiet de duoc o state nay hoac trigger transitions tu state nay

prerequisite.description: Dieu kien can thoa man truoc khi vao state nay (e.g. 'accepted_at != null')

id.description: Action ID (khop voi action field trong transitions)

description.description: Mo ta hanh dong cho developer va domain expert

idempotent.description: true = co the goi nhieu lan, ket qua nhu nhau (e.g. expire)

reversible.description: true = co the hoan tac (e.g. cancel draft); false = khong hoan tac (e.g. convert_to_order)
